scope: Git/JSON/links/bytes only. Does not validate a comparison proposition, run scientific SOURCE/test or evaluate saved scientific numbers. Validator is task-local, not scientific verification code.
w1_private_access: No content/index/lock/process/output reads or writes; public fixed sources only.

preservation.snapshot_scope: All parent tracked file bytes, parent top-level untracked file bytes, registered inactive-other-worktree HEAD/index/lock bytes. Active W1 is excluded from content/index/lock reads and writes; it may change independently. No claim of byte coverage of unregistered repositories or every untracked file in other worktrees.
preservation.snapshot_publication: Full filesystem snapshots retained in task-local /tmp, not committed; public report provides scope/counts/hashes. Local observations, not immutable CI or external reproduction.
preservation.start_scope: Baseline snapshot taken after authorized own worktree registration, before document writes. Own new branch/worktree/common registration changes excluded from protected-other-worktree comparison.
preservation.writes: Only dedicated document directory in own worktree and own task-local /tmp. Own branch/index/commit metadata only. No other process/lock/index/content intentionally modified.
